headline: Sell the chip pile in stages, fund power, data-center and healthcare names over six weeks
approach: We clear the names the target book does not want first — MU and AMD outright, then AVGO, AMZN and TSM in halves — and only trim NVDA at the end. Each buy is funded by cash already raised in that step or an earlier one, so nothing is bought on credit. AAPL and ANET stay untouched: they belong in the target book, and selling AAPL would book a taxable gain for no reason.
first_move: Sell all $612 of MU and all $832 of AMD at market today.

steps.sell: Sell all $612 of MU and all $832 of AMD at market.
steps.why: Clears the two weakest chip positions and funds the largest missing holding in one move.
steps.realizes: Books losses on both, usable against gains; do not rebuy either within 30 days.

steps.trigger: AVGO bounces after step 1 fills, or one week later at market
steps.sell: Sell $675 of AVGO, about half the position.
steps.why: Halves a 14% position without dumping it, and buys the power side of the AI build.
steps.realizes: Books a short-term loss on half of AVGO, which offsets your most expensive gains first.

steps.trigger: AVGO holds steady, about two weeks after step 2
steps.sell: Sell the remaining $674 of AVGO and all $628 of AMZN.
steps.buy: Buy $660 of LLY near $1,226.54 and $475 of NU near $14.62.
steps.why: Finishes the AVGO exit and adds two holdings that do not depend on the AI cycle.
steps.realizes: Books losses on both sales; no rebuy of AVGO or AMZN within 30 days.

steps.trigger: TSM recovers some of its loss, or four weeks in at market
steps.sell: Sell $775 of TSM, about half the position.
steps.buy: Buy $570 of SNOW near $256.22 and $475 of DLR near $194.58.
steps.why: Starts unwinding your second-largest chip holding and buys the data and landlord side.
steps.realizes: Books a short-term loss on half of TSM, offsetting your highest-taxed gains first.

steps.trigger: TSM still steady, about two weeks after step 4
steps.buy: Buy $475 of ON near $83.76 and $375 of SMCI near $27.24, stop $21.
steps.why: Completes the TSM exit and rebuilds chip exposure through cheaper, better-targeted names.
steps.realizes: Books the rest of the TSM loss; do not rebuy TSM within 30 days.

steps.trigger: NVDA recovers toward what you paid for it
steps.sell: Trim $606 of NVDA, keeping about $967 of it.
steps.buy: Buy $375 of APLD near $26.05, stop $19, and $285 of SMR near $7.82, stop $5.50.
steps.why: Brings chip weight down to target while keeping a real NVDA stake, and funds two speculative bets.
steps.realizes: Books a small short-term loss on the trimmed shares; no NVDA rebuy for 30 days.

guardrails: Stop selling into a sharp market-wide drop; wait for stability rather than dumping TSM or NVDA at their lows.
Stop and reassess if any name you own cuts guidance or loses a major customer.
Do not chase VRT, CEG or LLY if they have run well above the levels listed here.
Exit SMCI below $21 and APLD below $19, and skip the remaining speculative buys.
